title: All users may register devices with Entra ID

messages.businessImpact: Personal devices can register with the organisation's identity without any management applying, so they appear in the directory without being governed by it.
messages.technicalDetail: Registration is not join. Restricting it breaks personal device scenarios and app protection, so the right value depends on whether the organisation intends to support them.
remediation: Under Entra device settings, change Users may register devices to Selected and name the group that needs it, rather than leaving it at All.

None turns personal device registration off for everyone, which breaks app protection and personal Outlook access, so a subset is the setting to aim at unless the organisation has decided against personal devices entirely.
Whichever is chosen, control what a registered device may reach through app protection policies and Conditional Access rather than through this setting alone.
messages.cannotSee: Whether personal device use is intended is a policy decision this cannot infer, and an organisation that supports it deliberately will be reported here. Only the scope is read, not how many devices have registered through it, so a setting nobody has used reads the same as one in daily use.
